construction.profile_target: preserve the identity witness atom-count vector exactly
construction.candidate_selection: within each atom choose the required number of eligible groups with highest frozen Phase 2 objective priority; tie-break by group_id
construction.CM100_priority: descending frozen global-v0.8 rarity-weighted coverage score, then ascending SHA256(curated_seed|group_id), then group_id
construction.objective: additive integer priority rank from the frozen Phase 2 contract
construction.optimality_claim: exact maximum conditional on the witness atom-count vector only; no global profile-constrained optimality claim

acceptance.final_manifest_emission: only after both banks pass the independent validator
acceptance.failure_policy: retain provisional artifacts and report failure; do not relax constraints or continue to another neighborhood in this stage

interpretation_limits: a passing bank proves counterfactual profile feasibility and positive frozen-policy score separation only
objective separation is not a material downstream model effect
the conditional atom optimum is not a global optimum
SEARCH_EXHAUSTED or stage failure is not infeasibility
